definition: The full legal name of a ticketed passenger as printed on the Gravel Bay sailing manifest.
The calendar date of birth a passenger supplied when booking a sailing.
The email address the authority uses to send sailing notices to a passenger.
The mobile telephone number a passenger gave for disruption alerts.
The residential postal address held against a passenger account.
The vault token that stands in for the payment card used to buy a fare.
The last four digits of the payment card retained so a receipt can be found.
The bank account number a cancelled fare is refunded into.
The authority's permanent staff identifier for a member of a vessel crew.
The maritime competency certificate number a crew member holds.
The sailing and watch a crew member is rostered to work.
The serial printed on a boarding pass and unique to one passenger sailing.
The six character reference that identifies one booking across the estate.
The moment a boarding pass was scanned at the terminal gate.
The reference of an insurance claim raised after an incident at sea.
The amount an assessor put on a salvage claim after inspecting the damage.
The negotiated rate the authority pays for a berth at a partner harbour.
The date on which a commercial harbour agreement lapses unless renewed.
The total contracted value of a private vessel charter.
The engine temperature a vessel reported on its telemetry feed in celsius.
The percentage of usable fuel remaining in a vessel's tanks.
The compass heading a vessel reported at the last telemetry ping.
The authority's identifier for one hull in the Gravel Bay fleet.
The departure time published in the sailing timetable for a route.
The arrival time published in the sailing timetable for a route.
The predicted high tide height at a terminal in metres.
The public name of a Gravel Bay ferry terminal.
The short code that identifies a scheduled route between two terminals.
A free text note the bridge records about conditions during a sailing.
The maximum number of passengers a vessel is certified to carry.
